title: OZSW Workshop for Junior Researchers: Learning and Reasoning in Humans, Animals, and Machines
speaker: Keynote: Jan-Willem Romeijn (Groningen)
description:
One-day workshop organised by Matteo Colombo (Tilburg) and Nina Poth (Radboud) with the OZSW, for PhD students, postdocs and ReMa students working in philosophy of cognitive science, philosophy of science and related areas. Keynote plus four or five talks by junior researchers (20 min + 10 min Q&A). In person only, no streaming.

To present: send a title and 200-word abstract to ninalaura.poth@ru.nl and M.Colombo@tilburguniversity.edu by 15 November 2026 (notification by 22 November).
To attend: send a short e-mail to M.Colombo@tilburguniversity.edu. Registration opens 15 October and closes 11 December 2026.
